title: Pregnant Quartet #07
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. FOUR women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Hawaiian, in her mid 50s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her hips and rear so wide. A high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly projects forward prominently from her front, while behind it a rear so massively rounded and projecting dominates from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape, echoing the belly's own roundness from the opposite side. A full round bust above the belly, gigantic thick thighs. Her head looks small on top of her body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, wavy hair, real pores, real living eyes, 100 drop dangles piercings set with opals in gold-toned metal, wearing a single piece of rose-gold earrings. Painted in Norwegian rosemaling folk painting, a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of acanthus scrollwork wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, extreme gold extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Indian, in her early 40s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, sleek straight hair, real pores, real living eyes, 150 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in brass-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of silver a hair ornament. Painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic, a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide carved cream bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of leaf scrolls wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, extreme carved cream extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#3: Indian, in her early 50s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term multiples pregnancy. Her pregnant belly is exceptionally wide as well as high, stretched into a broad, taut, smoothly rounded dome far wider than an ordinary single pregnancy, the navel pushed flat and outward at its highest point, faint linea nigra running down its centre. A full heavy bust above it, wide round hips below, soft thick thighs and arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, braided hair, real pores, real living eyes, 5 clicker rings piercings set with amethysts in copper-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of gold a ring. Painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic, a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide ochre bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of spiral floral bands wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, extreme ochre extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#4: Japanese, in her early 30s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — a stunning hourglass figure carrying a full-term pregnancy, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projecting forward well past her own chest, the navel pushed slightly outward, and below the belly her hips flare wide and curvaceous. Her waistline has fully given way to the pregnancy's round, taut curve, no sharp cinch at the middle, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, long bleached platinum hair with a neon streak, a fierce, playful expression, sleek straight hair, real pores, real living eyes, 3 studs piercings set with pearls in silver-toned metal, wearing a single piece of rose-gold a necklace. Painted in Italian Deruta majolica, a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide cobalt-and-ochre bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of repeating floral border wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, extreme cobalt-and-ochre extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
